profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States
profile.summary:
Hello! I’m a Full Stack Developer experienced in delivering scalable, high-performance applications using TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, AWS, and more. Currently at Average.io, I’ve helped take the core product from concept to alpha release—designing RESTful APIs, optimizing front-end performance, and ensuring smooth deployments on AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda).

At Bloksy, I utilized GraphQL, Apollo, and PostgreSQL to build a robust CMS that boosted system performance by 20% and streamlined data exchange. My previous role at i-Showcase involved advanced technical support, resolving complex front-end and server-side issues, and implementing QA protocols to reduce post-deployment issues by 20%.

Backed by a background in psychology, I excel at understanding user needs and communicating complex ideas across diverse teams. I’m passionate about crafting intuitive web applications that drive engagement, enhance user experience, and scale seamlessly.

Let’s connect to discuss how I can contribute to building efficient, user-centric solutions for your organization!

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: TypeScript | JavaScript ES6+ | HTML5 | CSS3
Frameworks & Libraries: React.js | Node.js | Next.js | Express.js | Tailwind CSS | Apollo Server | Redux | JQuery | Bootstrap
Databases: MySQL | MongoDB | PostgreSQL | GraphQL | NoSQL
Tools & Services: AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) | Git | GitHub | Sequelize | Figma | WordPress | Jira | Wrike | Zendesk | E-Commerce 
Additional Concepts: MVC | OOP | Agile/Scrum
Spoken Languages:  English (Fluent) | Spanish (Fluent)

Check out my work at : 
Portfolio 💻 : https://www.arely.dev/
GitHub 📁 : https://github.com/a-riveragonzalez
Resume 📄 : https://drive.google.com/file/d/1dmOgW6cLu2aiT7rZeJrUnvIi59QSXlVo/view?usp=sharing

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Worked in a team of four engineers to build and deploy the core product and admin using Typescript, React, AWS, Node.js, and Next.js, taking the platform from concept to alpha release by setting up the infrastructure, coding features, and handling cloud integrations.
• Focused on designing scalable and maintainable solutions that can handle rapid growth and evolving user needs, optimizing both front-end and back-end performance through custom React hooks and reusable components, adherence to best practices (e.g., memoization) to limit component re-renders, and maintaining organized, readable code.
• Created RESTful APIs and front-end features to deliver a seamless user experience, enhancing the product’s overall stability and usability.
• Developed and optimized complex raw SQL queries and leveraged Sequelize for advanced database operations in PostgreSQL, resulting in streamlined data retrieval and improved query efficiency.
• Debugged AWS environments—including EC2, RDS, S3, and Lambda—to ensure smooth deployments, minimal downtime, and reliable serverless functions.
• Performed unit testing and QA on newly developed features while actively reporting and responding to reported bugs, facilitating rapid issue resolution and maintaining high software quality.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · Node.js · Next.js · PostgreSQL · SQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Utilized cutting-edge technologies including TypeScript, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Apollo, and GraphQL to develop robust and scalable solutions, resulting in a 20% increase in system performance and efficiency in building a comprehensive CMS.
• Implemented robust data models and APIs using GraphQL and Apollo, facilitating seamless data exchange between front-end and back-end systems, reducing data retrieval times by 25%.
• Engaged in an Agile development environment, participating in bi-weekly sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives, contributing to a 15% improvement in project delivery timelines.
• Applied expert knowledge of Next.js to deliver a responsive, user-centric interface for the CMS, improving user engagement by 30% and ensuring a seamless user experience across various devices and platforms.
• Leveraged Swimm for creating detailed, up-to-date documentation, significantly improving codebase understanding for new team members and maintaining consistent coding methodologies within the team.

positions.title: Technical Support Specialist
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Collaborated with a team of 5 software engineers to resolve complex technical challenges encompassing servers, databases, shopping carts, SMTP, custom functionality, front-end changes, and SEO, leading to an 80% reduction in issue resolution time and overall project agility.
• Resolved an average of 35 client front-end tickets per week by applying expertise in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, directly contributing to a 25% increase in client satisfaction ratings regarding web solution responsiveness.
• Initiated and executed comprehensive QA protocols and devised test cases for new features and bug fixes ensuring robust software quality and contributing to a 20% reduction in post-deployment issues, thus enhancing product reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Full Stack Web Development Teaching Assistant
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Assisted the instructor with classroom management by taking attendance, tracking class time, and facilitating student coding exercises, resulting in an increase in overall student participation and engagement
• Identified and resolved complex bugs in code by utilizing debugging tools, analyzing error logs, and testing code in multiple environments, resulting in a reduction in overall error rate for students
• Provided support to students outside of class time by holding weekly office house, conducting individual meetings, and providing in depth feedback on assignments, resulting in an overall student success rate
positions.insights: Skills: MySQL · Git · HTML · jQuery · React.js · Debugging · JavaScript · NoSQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Node.js · Express.js · Responsive Web Design · MongoDB · Web Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

positions.title: Behavior Specialist
positions.description:
• Implemented behavioral treatment plans that involved teaching individuals’ adaptive, communication, self-care, and social skills to improve their quality of life.
• Collaborated with clients’ case manager to brainstorm and implement new creative and individualized treatment plans and interventions for 26 clients
• Trained over 40 new behavioral aides to be job ready within two weeks
positions.insights: Skills: Special Education · CPI Training · Applied Behavior Analysis

positions.description:
• Produced high quality frames while fostering positive customer relationships.
• Completed 50 framing orders with high attention to detail weekly while balancing delivering high quality customer service 
• Increased custom framing department’s quarterly sales revenue by 20%
